title_zh: 试吃后决定义卖蛋糕品种

scenario.goal_zh: 试吃橙味蛋糕后决定将其加入义卖，并确认烘焙数量与装盒分工

context_zh: 邻居为周末筹款义卖试做蛋糕，通过试吃决定数量和烘焙分工。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Before I bake another batch, would you try this orange cake?

sentences.speaker: Gavin
sentences.text: Of course. One bite should be enough to tell whether it needs more sugar.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: I used less than last time. What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Gavin
sentences.text: I am amazed at how much orange I can taste. It does not need any more sugar.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Would it be a useful addition to the cake stall, or do we already have too much?

sentences.speaker: Gavin
sentences.text: We have plenty of chocolate cake, so this would give people a choice.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Then I will make two orange cakes. Could you bring the boxes?

sentences.speaker: Gavin
sentences.text: Yes. I will bring four, so there is room for the cakes without stacking them.
